full_name: Chris Bowler | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
title: 2016–2017 Medicine Grass Fellow Centre National de la Recherche Scientifique (France)
bio: Chris Bowler is the CNRS Director of Research at the Institut de Biologie de l’Ecole Normale Supérieure in Paris. Using genomics approaches, he studies the biology of plants and a group of marine phytoplankton known as diatoms.
